|strategy=By [mailto:jediknight@decipher.com Justin Pakes, Jedi Knight]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/endor/dark/small/commanderigar.html</ref>

If you are playing Light Side and you stumble out form the forest to see Igar commanding [[Tempest 1]] - there is one rule. Don't mess with him! This guy is a the bad daddy of the mechanical behemoths. Adds 3 to their power, adds one battle destiny. Looking at his statistics on [[Tempest 1]] (below) he makes a fearsome sight. Now you'd think a man with that much talent would threaten the other up and coming Imperial Officer, [[General Veers]]? But in actual fact they get along quite well! Get them together, and a cancelling destiny they can go! That's a [[Grand Moff Tarkin{{!}}Tarkin]]/[[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] combo right there!

Combo: No Subtlety. Power 9 and 2 battle destiny draws. Immune to attrition &lt; 4. Sometimes the obvious is the best.
